problem: The shared Engine game backend projected vehicle headlight cones as local lights but had no local-light occlusion maps. Previous shadow filtering fixes covered sun shadows only.

implementation.optIn: LightSpec.castShadow on polar cones; TheGame enables it for full headlamps and excludes aggregate diffuse-only lights.
implementation.budget: Two nearby independent 512x512 depth layers; stable source slots, distance fade at 25..45m; 2 MiB depth storage.
implementation.casters: Separate light-frustum culling, same opacity/decal/emission eligibility as sun shadows, ordinary and relief geometry, shared GPU instance streams and independent per-light instance lists.
implementation.receivers: Depth comparisons attenuate diffuse, specular and coat direct-light terms together, leaving unrelated lights and environment reflections intact.
implementation.lifecycle: Removed/off lights clear grid slots; map/frame/receiver buffers are disposed; GPU timestamps include both local shadow passes. Allocation/pass counts are included in renderer diagnostics.
implementation.limits: Only the nearest two opted-in beams cast local shadows. Volumetric fog transport is not shadowed. Native performance was not benchmarked.

verification.engineTypesAndBuild: bun run typecheck; bun run build: passed
verification.engineTests: node --test test/spot-shadow.test.mjs test/render-pipeline-readiness.test.mjs test/shadow-stability.test.mjs test/render-visibility-plan.test.mjs test/render-pipeline-plan.test.mjs test/renderer-post.test.mjs test/render-profiler.test.mjs: 50 passed
verification.gameBuild: bun run build in ../thegame: passed; production user tab reloaded and reconnected
verification.liveGame: Viewed current taxi and nearby traffic in night preset with TAA enabled, no captured browser error logs. Frame retained; quantitative light/blocker verification belongs to the controlled production-renderer fixture, not a pixel-matched live traffic replay.
verification.descriptorReference: Refreshed shader/layout fingerprints for the intentional new shadow bindings. Previous reference retained at artifacts/reflection-qa/pipeline-descriptors-before-spot-shadows.json and recorded by previousReferenceSha256.
